text:
Sophie: Heads-up: BetaWorks is seeing a sharp billing increase and a lot of Decrypt AccessDenied beginning ~02:12 UTC after we flipped their CMK rotation. Ticket BW-9021. Can we triage?

Emily (support): Customer reported ~5k failed decrypts over ~30m, falling back to our soft-fallback tier. Contact is nate@betaworks.io. They use our tenant-KMS proxy with per-tenant aliasing.

Sophie: App error excerpts they pasted: 
```
2026-03-05T02:13:07Z ERROR KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException
 keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222222222222:key/ee11-rotated
 encryptionContext={\"tenant\":\"betaworks\",\"svc\":\"payments\"}
 trace=rid-abc456
```

Javier: Two hypotheses: (A) grant token cache on proxy stale after rotation, (B) encryption-context headers dropped/normalized by proxy or fronting nginx. Both can lead to AccessDenied. Also check if the new key's key policy allows the proxy IAM role.

Alex: I pulled KMS metrics around that time: p95 latency spiked 90ms->350ms and error rate for Decrypt increased. High latency + retries will magnify billing.

Sean: Quick repro I ran in a disposable tenant: create key1 + grant to proxy; switch alias to key2; proxy kept cached grantId -> intermittent AccessDenied until grant reissued. Repro steps:
1) aws kms create-key (key1)
2) aws kms create-grant --key-id key1 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::222222222222:role/tenant-proxy-role --operations Decrypt
3) rotate alias to key2
4) proxy still sends cached GrantToken -> KMS returns AccessDenied for some calls

CLI snippet I used:
```
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://c.bin --encryption-context '{"tenant":"betaworks","svc":"payments"}' --key-id alias/bw-cmk
```
If proxy rewrites headers (e.g., clears x-amz-encryption-context) call fails.

Sophie: Can someone check CloudTrail for Decrypt events from that tenant between 02:10-02:45? Customer is worried audit logs are missing.

Javier: Quick CloudTrail check: we see Decrypt events but principal is our proxy role arn:aws:sts::222222222222:assumed-role/tenant-proxy-role/session-xyz for many calls. There are also small gaps where requests hit our internal cache (no outgoing KMS call) or were rejected before making KMS calls.

kms-bot: KeyRotation for alias/bw-cmk completed 2026-03-05T02:09:58Z.

infra-bot: deploy/proxy/2026-03-05T01:58:20Z started by @ops-oncall.

Emily (support): BetaWorks wants immediate remediation: either rollback rotation or a config change to avoid billing. They also want confirmation about audit completeness.

Alex: Short-term mitigations: (1) purge proxy grant-token cache + restart proxy pods (2) re-issue grants for new key and ensure grant has Decrypt to proxy role (3) check proxy code for header normalization - common bug is nginx config like `proxy_set_header X-Amz-Encryption-Context \"\";` which wipes the header.

Sean: I'm rolling a cache invalidation now; will also force fresh grant creation via a one-off job. ETA 12m.

Javier: Looking at key policy for new key: policy allows `kms:Decrypt` for the account but the proxy relies on explicit grant IDs for performance. After rotation grants referencing the old KeyId won't apply. Need to issue new grant(s).

Sophie: Are we leaking encryption-context contents in CloudTrail? Customer asked if PII might be exposed.

kms-bot: Note: AWS CloudTrail records the presence of encryption context but does not log its contents by default - only a boolean flag appears (for security reasons). So we are not exposing encryption context JSON to CloudTrail.

Emily (support): For the customer reply I'll say: root cause is a combination of grant-token caching and proxy header handling during key rotation; mitigation taken: cache purge, new grants, rolling restart. We're recommending they pause auto-rotation for now until we ship a proxy fix.

Alex: Follow-ups: add an internal check that flags grants older than 1h for tenant CMKs and a console indicator of last grant issue time; instrument proxy to emit the forwarded headers to our audit stream (redact values).

Sean: After purge and forcing grants, decrypt failures dropped to single-digit per minute and billing normalized. Keeping watch on p99 KMS latency for 4h. Opened GH issue infra/proxy#1187 "handle CMK rotation + grant-token lifecycle" and linked BW-9021.

Javier: One more note: if the proxy assumes role without passing STS session tags and we rely on those tags in key policy conditions, Decrypt can fail post-rotation. Verify assume-role call includes `Tags` and that session policies allow passing them.

Sophie: Good work. Emily - draft the customer timeline and send to BetaWorks with what we did and next steps. We'll do a postmortem on Monday and include action owners. :white_check_mark:
